text:
Anya: Heads-up — saw a cluster of GPU OOMs on pool-3 at ~11:04 UTC during the synthetic traffic ramp. Root cause looks like KV cache fragmentation + large prefill sequences holding many small slabs. Opening thread to collect quick ideas.

Devon: Any flame graphs or pprof from the runtime during the spike?

Anya: Attached a short perf summary (https://internal.redwood/links/1769998888/perf-snip) — but TL;DR: decode path memory usage jumped because prefill bumped slab count; allocator couldn't coalesce fast enough.

Maria: Could we try per-request kv caps (e.g., 8MB) + segmented leases so a single long prefill doesn't pin large contiguous ranges?

Srinivas: +1. Also think about soft compaction: when free slab fragments exceed X% trigger a background compaction that prefers older/free-but-frag slots.

Anya: Draft config I was testing: ```json
{"kv_segment_size": "2MB", "per_request_kv_cap": "8MB", "compact_threshold_pct": "35", "compact_batch_ms": "50"}
```

Devon: Bench notes?

bench-bot: bench-run/1769991: workload=chat-2k, concurrency=40. Baseline: p99=180ms, mem_headroom=22%. Experiment(with compaction): p99=195ms (+8%), mem_headroom=44% (+22%). OOMs: 0 vs 3.

Maria: Latency hit is acceptable if OOMs disappear. Can we mitigate the p99 by doing compaction during idle gaps and reducing compact_batch_ms?

Srinivas: Also test adaptive per-request cap: start at 8MB, if allocator fragmentation > 40% then drop to 6MB for next N requests.

Anya: Good call. I can prototype an LRU-aware lease that demotes older segments first.

Devon: Need rollout plan: feature flag gated, canary on pool-3, metrics to watch: p99, OOM_count, kv_frag_pct, avg_slots_per_segment.

Anya: I'll open a PR with runtime flag and metrics export. Can someone add an alert on kv_frag_pct > 50%?

ops-bot: alert: created alert 'kv_frag_pct_high' -> paging to eng-oncall at 50%.

bench-bot: Also ran a variant: compact-only-on-low-cpu -> p99=182ms, mem_headroom=38%. Suggest gating compaction on cpu_util < 70%.

Maria: That seems promising. Let's try combined heuristics: compact when frag>35% AND cpu<70% OR during async idle windows.

Srinivas: One more: we should avoid global stop-the-world compaction. Do chunked compaction with small pause windows to keep decode latency stable.

Anya: Agree. Action items: (1) PR w/ config + flags (Anya), (2) canary rollout on pool-3 + added metrics/alert (Devon/ops), (3) bench adaptive per-request cap and cpu gated compaction (bench-bot/Maria), (4) implement chunked compaction algorithm (Srinivas).

Devon: Timeline?

Anya: I'll aim to have PR + bench results by EOD Wednesday.

Devon: :thumbsup:
